assertions.claim: Step 1: immediately remove soaked clothing and shoes — damage is worst where clothing pressed.
assertions.cn_span: 立刻脱掉沾上的衣服鞋袜（衣服兜住的地方伤得最重）

assertions.claim: Flush skin and eyes at least 15 min per the CDC institute, 20–30 min per the Hunan emergency-management document — take the longer.
assertions.cn_span: 皮肤和眼睛都至少 15 分钟，另一份官方口径给到 20 到 30 分钟，就长的那个

assertions.claim: Eyes flushed with lids held apart, then straight to ophthalmology; never rub.
assertions.cn_span: 眼睛撑开眼皮冲，冲完直接去眼科

assertions.claim: Room-temp or slightly warm water, never hot; nothing on the fresh wound; no cross-neutralizing acid with alkali (Hunan's 'neutralizing solution' is a pre-stocked dedicated rinse).
assertions.cn_span: 用常温或微温水，不用热水；创面上别涂任何东西，也别拿另一种酸碱去中和

assertions.claim: Workplace cases go as occupational disease and work injury; employer bears treatment and examination costs.
assertions.cn_span: 工作中发生的按职业病和工伤走，救治和检查费用由单位承担

assertions.claim: Dry powders like lime and cement dust are brushed off first, then flushed; the book deliberately omits the contested concentrated-sulfuric-acid variant.
assertions.cn_span: 石灰粉、水泥粉这类干粉先刷掉再冲水

assertions.claim: On the first workday, locate eyewash stations and showers in advance — don't search after the accident.
assertions.cn_span: 上岗第一天就把洗眼器和冲淋装置的位置看好
